details_checked: Candidate selects parallel v2 rather than unsafe v1 alteration, locks/validates vector dimension, specifies indexes and a non-destructive v1 compatibility path.
Chunk identities, canonical boundaries, parent replacement/removal, lexical lag behavior, provenance and live-authorized citations are explicit.
Durable chunk-row leases, bounded batch validation/retry/toxic isolation and current-hash/identity conditional commits preserve stale-write safety without DB transactions across provider calls.
FTS/vector work uses separately owned sessions, applies authoritative predicates before all limits, fuses rank-only RRF and retains KB/diversity caps.
The shared PostgreSQL embedding cache is hash-only/TTL/classified and every cache and snapshot use revalidates current authority; immutable snapshot rules cover two same-model agents.
File map, flags, dual write/shadow/canary/cutover/retirement, reconciliation, rollback, gates, failure injection and measurement-separate LLM latency are complete.

B+C are implemented as the hybrid chunked pgvector target.
D is rejected; E is deferred behind measured pgvector/headroom and scale triggers.
F1 is adopted, F2 is conditional future work, and F3 is rejected for the one-model constraint.

proposed_artifact: Approved registered candidate v0: parallel chunked pgvector v2 with deterministic FTS/vector RRF, durable batched embedding leases, scoped PostgreSQL query-vector cache, and immutable authorized snapshots reused by conditional same-model agents; v1 remains rollback fallback until reconciled retirement.
requirements_covered: Exact additive v2 schema, dimension contract, indexes, compatibility and cleanup are covered.
Hybrid rank fusion, chunk lifecycle, durable batch refresh and cold-query overlap/cache are covered.
Current authorization/provenance/citation protections are asserted before limits and live-validated for cache/snapshot reuse.
Two-agent same-snapshot integration, files/phases, gates/metrics/failure tests, rollback/stops, options and retained unknowns are covered.
summary: The candidate satisfies all direct-brief requirements with concrete algorithms and a reversible rollout; no substantiated blocker or gap remains.
